routine.name: Daily package tracking status
routine.description: Every morning, searches Gmail for shipping-notification emails, extracts any tracking code found in each message (after labels like "Tracking number", "Rastreio", "Código de rastreamento", or a bare postal-format code), looks up the current status of every unique code via the tracking API, and sends one Telegram/notify message listing each package's status. Sends nothing if no shipping emails with tracking codes are found.

writes.package_label: Write a short label in the form 'Vendor — Item' (max 6 words) identifying the package based on this shipping notification email's sender and content. Keep product names as written, do not translate them.

params.label: Search terms (Gmail query)
params.default: tracking OR rastreio OR "código de rastreamento" OR shipped OR enviado
